label: kotoni-group
title: ことに〜
meaning: I decided, it was decided, it is a rule

notes.text:


日本へ行くことにする

I have decided to go to japan





日本へ行くことになった

It has been decided I will go to japan





日本へ行くことになっている

I go to Japan 

(eg as a rule, once a month)
notes.html:

日本へ行くことにする
I have decided to go to japan


日本へ行くことになった
It has been decided I will go to japan


日本へ行くことになっている
I go to Japan
(eg as a rule, once a month)

comments.text:
according to a textbook I once used: 



Use にする to indicate a decision made at one's own will; use になる to indicate a decision or change of circumstances that is generated in the course of one's dealings with others.
comments.html:
according to a textbook I once used:

Use にする to indicate a decision made at one's own will; use になる to indicate a decision or change of circumstances that is generated in the course of one's dealings with others.

comments.text: Generally, こと is a nominalizer that makes whatever preceds it into a noun or a nominal. 行くこと would be "the act of going" 食べること would mean the act of eating, etc.
